description: Return up to 200 submitted or approved time entries to draft with one required comment (up to 2000 characters). Only the assigned approver or an organization owner/admin may return an entry. Each id returns returned or a refusal reason: a draft that was never returned is not_submitted; running timers, locked periods, and billed or written-off entries are refused. Each returned entry is audited. The owner keeps seeing the comment while editing and can submit again; approval clears it. Repeating a return with the same comment is safe.
